content: सारङ्ग {%a.%} (-ङ्गी|{%f.%}) [सारम् अङ्गमस्य शकं˚] Spotted, variegated. .{@-ङ्गः@} .²1 The variegated colour. .²2 The spotted deer; एष राजेव दुष्यन्तः सारङ्गेणातिरंहसा <ls>Ś. 1. 5</ls>. .²3 A deer in general; सारङ्गास्ते जललबमुचः सूचयिष्यन्ति मार्गम् <ls>Me. 21</ls> (where it is preferable to take this sense rather than that of ‘elephant’ or ‘bee’). .²4 A lion. .²5 An elephant. .²6 A large black bee; <ls>Mb. 12. 178. 7</ls>. .²7 The cuckoo. .²8 A large crane. .²9 The flamingo. .²10 A peacock. .²11 An umbrella. .²12 A cloud. .²13 A garment. .²14 Hair. .²15 A conch-shell. .²16 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²17 The god of love. .²18 A lotus. .²19 Camphor. .²20 A bow. .²21 Sandal. .²22 A kind of musical instrument. .²23 An ornament. .²24 Gold. .²25 The earth. .²26 The Chātaka bird. .²27 A flower. .²28 Night. .²29 Light. .²30 A devotee; सारङ्गाणां पदाम्बुजम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 11. 26</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> सारं श्रीकृष्णां गायन्ति ते भक्ताः). .²31 A particular Rāga.
सारङ्गी .²1 A kind of stringed instrument, violin. .²2 A kind of spotted deer.
